title: Connect your AI to my free open source vehicle physics system 🚙💨
author: PaceGame
selftext:
Connect your AI to my docs and see if it can build you a really good car controller!

Hey, this one is for you AI game devs. **I wrote a huge open-source manual** about car physics, and the whole thing is also one **plain text file for LLM**, so you can hand it straight to your AI. Give it a try.

This was a crazy amount of work, so I’d really appreciate your feedback.  
**I hope it helps you!!**

comments.author: catbluesgames
comments.body:
Nice resource, thanks  
If we use frontier models, isn't all this information already baked into the model?

replies.author: PaceGame
replies.body: Yes, the AI already knows a lot about physics. But it still has to figure out how everything fits together, often by searching the web and trying different approaches. Here it has everything in one place, with examples and explanations of how the parts work together. That should make things a lot easier.

comments.author: jimbojohndoe
comments.body: Thanks, I was just thinking about a car game for my racing wheel controllers.
